description: Add a file the tester can upload during the test: up to 25 MB, up to 10 files per test. REST: send the raw bytes as the body with the file name in the X-File-Name header (or ?name=), or JSON {name, contentBase64}. MCP: name and contentBase64. A file with the same name replaces the old one. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/
name: add_test_file
title: Add a test file
